meta.source: Nathan 2026-10-14: agents communicate using Tesla's resonance ideas
meta.verdict: Adopted from the Tesla research mapping: Wardenclyffe's 'one plant, millions of instruments' = broadcast bus with tuned selective receivers = publish-subscribe keyed on frequency. For information this is sound (it IS radio); Tesla's failure was power, not signaling.

resonant_mesh.law: Agents communicate by resonance. Every signal is broadcast on a frequency; every agent carries tuned receivers. Only agents tuned to the signal's frequency receive it.
resonant_mesh.mechanism: Publish-subscribe keyed on frequency. Broadcast bus + 'carefully attuned receiving circuits' (Tesla's phrase). Vera routes with frequency awareness.
resonant_mesh.addressing: Frequency-division addressing: an agent's tuned band IS its address. Standing-wave eigenmodes as the orthogonal channel basis.
resonant_mesh.selectivity: Q factor governs selectivity: sharper tuning = narrower bands = more addressable channels, but harder to hit. Frequency crowding (agents on nearby bands) causes interference — the mesh must manage Q per channel.
integration: Regulatory layer emit_signal/send primitives ride the mesh (already spec'd).
Kuramoto entrainment (already spec'd) is the phase-locking physics underneath.
Directed information I(X^n -> Y^n) (already spec'd) audits who-influenced-whom on the mesh.
honest_limits: Resonance gives selective communication, not computation.
Standing-wave nodes are blind spots by construction.
Star-topology hub = single point of failure (Wardenclyffe's lesson) — the mesh must survive hub loss; Marconi's cheaper distributed approach won for a reason.
